headline: Nevish Line And Callahan Passage Flare Under Fierce Assaults
war_summary: Combat across the central and northern fronts has escalated sharply, with Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy enduring relentless infantry clashes while Callahan's Passage re-ignited into active territorial contest. Nevish Line remains the war's most volatile theater, registering ten base transitions in the last two hours alone as fighting surges around Grief Mother, The Scrying Belt, and Unruly alongside over 3,400 fresh casualties. In Linn of Mercy, four recent base exchanges at Rotdust and Outwich Ranch pushed regional losses past 3,100 in two hours. Action has also reopened in Callahan's Passage, where two clashes at Crumbling Post broke previous quiet and generated more than 2,500 casualties. Meanwhile, direct base flips paused in Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse, though heavy attrition persists. Severe casualty spikes in Mooring County and Clahstra indicate mounting pressure across flanking sectors, with Mooring absorbing over 3,200 casualties in the latest two-hour interval without further ground changing hands.
